title: Korean Cucumber Salad (Oi Muchim)
description: Crisp, spicy-sweet banchan that cuts through rich, saucy mains. The ingredient list is well-sourced; the ratios are a middle-of-the-range starting point.

confidence.note: Cross-referenced. The ingredient list is well-sourced; the ratios are a middle-of-the-range starting point.

steps.text: Slice the cucumbers ({{cucumbers}}) thinly. Toss with the salt ({{salt}}) and leave 10 minutes, then drain off the water that comes out.
Whisk the soy ({{soy}}), vinegar ({{vinegar}}), gochugaru ({{gochugaru}}), sesame oil ({{sesame-oil}}), sugar ({{sugar}}) and grated garlic ({{garlic}} clove) together.
Toss the cucumber through the dressing with the spring onion ({{spring-onion}}).
Taste and adjust: more vinegar to brighten, more gochugaru for heat, a pinch more sugar to round it out. Finish with the sesame seeds ({{sesame}}).

notes.title: Cucumber
notes.text: Lebanese is the best Australian supermarket option here. Thin skin, few seeds, stays crisp.
